## Quality and Integrity Checklist

- [ ] Zero JavaScript introduced (pure HTML5 and CSS3 preserved).
- [ ] Form action destinations remain strictly pointed to official Google HTTPS endpoints.

- [ ] Verified across Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge.
